Rule: Before confirmation require active customer, ship-to, product, positive quantity, valid price, currency and requested date. Drafts may be incomplete.
Rationale: Avoid knowingly releasing incomplete orders; field list proposed, not a SAP default.

Rule: Every open exception needs one accountable role, next action and next review date.
Rationale: Daily review proposed to prevent unowned handoffs.

Rule: Keep requested receipt and initial confirmed receipt dates separately; later changes must not overwrite the original promise.
Rationale: Prevents improving on-time delivery by moving the denominator date.

Rule: Partial deliveries require customer agreement recorded on the order; default to review when unknown.
Rationale: A partial shipment can add cost or disrupt customer operations.

Rule: Credit release is a Finance responsibility; Sales and Warehouse may request review but not self-release. Manual order blocks retain their own reasons.
Rationale: Separation of duties; actual authorization model unvalidated.

Rule: Capture dispatch, goods-issue posting and receipt as separate events. Never treat goods issue as proof of customer receipt.
Rationale: Correct service measurement and posting reconciliation.

Rule: Cancel before dispatch only after checking dependent documents; after dispatch route to controlled return/reversal review.
Rationale: Avoid deleting history; full returns redesign is out of scope.

Rule: Finance reviews billable and unbilled exceptions each business day; escalate items still unbilled on the next review.
Rationale: Proposed daily operating cadence, not a proven 24-hour SAP service level.

Rule: Bill only eligible quantity once; preserve correction links and original posted documents.
Rationale: Invoice correctness and retry safety; exact system configuration unresolved.

Rule: Allocate only to supported customer/invoice matches; preserve partial and unallocated balances without automatic write-off.
Rationale: No invented tolerance or forced clearing.

Rule: Aggregate child records to their intended parent grain before combining measures.
Show report as-of time and preserve critical change history; do not present missing evidence as zero.
